TRENDING.label: 🟢 TREND FOLLOWING ENGINE
TRENDING.rationale: Captures massive multi-candle continuation waves with wide trailing stops (Target R:R 1:3.50 – 1:5.00+).

RANGING.label: 🟡 MEAN REVERSION ENGINE
RANGING.rationale: Captures clean swing mean-reversion between value area boundaries (Target R:R 1:2.50 – 1:3.50).

DEFENSIVE.label: ⚪ CAPITAL PRESERVATION ENGINE
DEFENSIVE.rationale: Prevents capital attrition in choppy, low-liquidity volatility compression zones.
